# NEGATIVE CONTROLS — shapes that must NOT match, so the rules are known to be
# scoped rather than merely loud. A rule that fires on everything is retired by
# whoever it interrupts, and then the real token walks through the hole.

TELEGRAM_SECRET_NAME = "life-platform/telegram"

header = "X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token"
